name: Ocean Homeward:Soul Summoner Survivors
description:
About This Game

Set sail and guide the wandering spirits, blazing a Homeward path amid the raging tides of the nether Ocean.

Between life and death lies a forgotten nether Ocean. Its waves never calm, and countless greedy sea monsters lurk beneath hidden currents, devouring restless spirits and plunging the waters into eternal chaos. You are a Soul Summoner bearing a sacred duty. To quiet the curse of this Ocean, you must set sail, break through desperate swarms of foes, and lead the lost spirits along their Homeward journey.

Summon Spirits, Form Your Strongest Team

Scattered across the perilous Ocean are ancient spirits of great power. Once legendary warriors, mages and assassins, they now wander lost in the nether depths. Explore randomly generated waters to awaken them, each with unique skills and combat roles. Recruit them to your side, build your exclusive spirit team, and stand together against endless hordes of monsters.

Survive the Onslaught, Forge Your Unique Build

Every voyage brings an unpredictable new adventure. Face overwhelming numbers of enemies and move nimbly to survive the relentless assault. Gather soul fragments as you fight, unlock and upgrade powerful skills and weapons at will. Shape devastating mage builds or deadly critical-strike spirit warriors; every voyage offers a brand-new strategic experience on the Ocean.

Guide Spirits Homeward, Uncover the Ocean’s Mysteries

Battle is not only for survival, but for redemption. Defeat fearsome sea bosses, purify corrupted waters, and safely escort gathered spirits Homeward to the underworld. As your journey unfolds, you will unravel the hidden truths of the nether Ocean and fulfill your ultimate destiny as a Soul Summoner.

Outside Run Progression, Forge Your Ocean Legend

A rich progression system lets you build your own legend upon the Ocean. Recovered spirits unlock exclusive talents, boosting your strength for every voyage. Complete stages to earn soul coins and obtain rare equipment. With multiple rarities and complete gear set systems, you can unlock unique playstyles and combat identities. Visit the nether blacksmith to refine equipment affixes and craft one-of-a-kind builds. Unlock legendary captains and their iconic vessels, wield new power, and embark on fresh adventures across the Ocean.

Set sail at once, Soul Summoner. Boundless treasures and mighty allies await. Whether this vast blue Ocean regains its peace lies entirely in your hands.
short_desc: Play as a Soul Summoner, sail the nether Ocean, survive monster hordes. Awaken spirits, collect soul fragments, craft gear sets and build unique combat styles. Upgrade spirits, forge affixes, unlock legendary captains and vessels. Purify the Ocean, lead spirits Homeward, uncover nether sea secrets.
